name: Filled Brown Waterskin
summary: In the Barrens, the Filled Brown Waterskin carries fresh water from the pond below Brine's hut. Aspiring shaman bring it to her to begin brewing sapta, used to commune with water spirits.

sections.title: A Life-Giving Drought
sections.body: The pond beneath Brine's hut is a rare source of fresh water in the Barrens. Nearby quilboar fight fiercely over it, and a novice shaman sees how scarce water can drive creatures to defend what sustains them.

faq.q: What is the Filled Brown Waterskin used for?
aliases: what do i do with filled brown waterskin
faq.answer: You bring the water to Brine at her hut in the southern Barrens. She uses it to begin preparing sapta, a draught that lets shaman perceive and commune with water spirits.

faq.q: Where does this water come from?
faq.answer: The water comes from a small freshwater pool just down the ridge beneath Brine's isolated hut. Local quilboar fiercely contest the pool.

faq.q: Why do the quilboar fight over this water source?
aliases: why is water sacred to quilboar
faq.answer: Rain is exceedingly rare in the arid Barrens, so the quilboar hold feasts when it comes. They guard natural springs against outsiders, even to the death.

angles.text: As a shaman, you fetch this water as Brine's first practical test during the Call of Water. It teaches you to respect the balance and fierce passions surrounding water.
